δαμῆναι: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. pass. inf.: ‘to be overcome’ (of death or fate) · also used of overpowering a god by main force (θεὸς ... δαμῆναι ’a god is hard to subdue’), not only of death or fate
δοιοὺς: δοιοί — two (poetic alternative to δύο); numeral adj., masc. acc. pl.
δολιχὸν: δολιχός — long; masc. acc. sg. (δολιχὸν πλόον ’a long voyage’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δόρυ: ’a long (spear)’
θέσθε: τίθημι — put, place; aor. mid. 2 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσθε): ’you put (in your minds)’
λέλυντο: λύω — loose, undo; plpf. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐλέλυντο): ’had come undone’
μαρναμένοισι: μάρναμαι — fight; pres. part. mid., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic μαρναμένοις)
μεθείη: μεθίημι — let go, release; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish subordinate to a condition: ’in hope that it might release (me)’
νέμεσιν: νέμεσις — righteous anger, retribution; fem. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’indignation’
νεμεσσῶμαι: νεμεσσάομαι — be indignant at, disapprove of; pres. 1 sg. mid., contracted, epic doubled σ (= Attic νεμεσῶμαι), + dat. · also + acc. of the person and an infinitive: ’resent (you) for …’ (οὔ σε νεμεσσῶμαι κεχολῶσθαι)
ξίφεσίν: ξίφος — sword; neut. dat. pl., accented before enclitic τε
πέποιθα: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα, with present sense: trust, rely on (+ dat.); 1 sg.
πυκνοὶ: πυκνός — thick, close-set; adj., masc. nom. pl.
τελευτήσεσθαι: τελευτάω — accomplish, bring to an end; fut. mid. inf. with passive sense: ’to be fulfilled, to come to pass’
φεύξεσθαι: φεύγω — flee, escape; fut. inf. mid., in indirect statement after ὀΐομαι: ’will escape’
ἀνάλκιδες: ἄναλκις — without might, strengthless, feeble (ἀ- + ἀλκή); adj., masc. nom. pl., predicate
ἀντίλοχον: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. acc. sg.
ἀργαλέῳ: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; masc. dat. sg.
ἀσφαλέως: ἀσφαλής — safe, sure, steady; adv. ἀσφαλέως: ’steadily, unfalteringly’
ἐάγη: ἄγνυμι — break; aor. 3 sg. pass., augmented with lengthened vowel: ’was broken’
ἐγίγνετο: γίγνομαι — become, come about, come to be; impf. 3 sg.
ἔγχεσιν: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. pl.: ’with spears’ (dat. of respect)
ἔμιμνον: μίμνω — stay, wait, remain; impf. 3 pl., epic reduplicated present of μένω (= Attic ἔμενον)
ἔφασκον: φημί — say, assert; impf. 1 sg., iterative in -σκ- (epic): ’I kept saying’
ὁρῶμαι: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg. mid. with active sense (epic): ’I behold’
